question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d268de1780118fe8e57d922fa8655b69ba41f4de0d48128ec644176141fc7f2c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: One additional composite triangle formed by combining smaller ones → 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d268de1780118fe8e57d922fa8655b69ba41f4de0d48128ec644176141fc7f2c.png] 

Thus, 3 (small)+3 (medium)+3 (large)+1=10**​**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**
